incidents.title: Payment schema change broke order creation
incidents.root_cause: payment-service changed the response shape of /payment/charge (removed 'transactionId' field, replaced with 'txnRef'). order-service was reading 'transactionId' directly and started throwing null errors on every checkout.

incidents.title: Auth token expiry change locked out payment flow
incidents.root_cause: auth-service shortened JWT expiry from 24h to 1h without notifying downstream teams. payment-service's long-running subscription job used cached tokens and started failing auth checks mid-transaction.

incidents.title: Inventory reservation race condition during flash sale
incidents.root_cause: inventory-service's /inventory/reserve endpoint was modified to skip a lock check for performance, causing double-booking of stock when order-service issued concurrent requests.

incidents.title: Notification queue backup delayed order confirmations
incidents.root_cause: notification-service database migration locked the notification_log table for 10 minutes, causing order-service's confirmation step to time out and orders to appear stuck.
